falsification_conditions.condition: Primary equity index closes at least 4% above the high of the current pattern-match window within 14 days, and similarity to mini_top_2019_jun falls below 50%.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The June 2019 mini-top analog failed; upside continuation would make UNKNOWN/HOLD the wrong call.

falsification_conditions.condition: Primary equity index falls 6% or more from the latest close within 14 days and VIX closes above 30.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Phase is no longer unknown; a confirmed risk-off break means HOLD was too passive.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 75, or at or below 30, within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The moderate 55 reading that supports an indeterminate hold is invalidated — either blowoff is confirmed or the blowoff thesis is dead.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
